text:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize the webinar abstracts + speaker ops. Proposed theme: 'Practical inference economics for product teams'. Need 3 concise abstracts (demo, benchmarks, enterprise readiness), speaker availability, and a rehearsal plan. Who can own which piece?

devon: I can own benchmarks. Will pull p95/p99 and cost-per-1k tokens. Need numbers by Tue EOD.

sam: I'll draft the demo abstract. @eric can you confirm demo scope (live vs prerecorded)? :raised_hands: 

eric: I can do live but want prerecorded fallback. Need staging Dedicated access + a short checklist for the failover.

maria: Plan sketch: 10m live demo, 8m benchmarks, 12m panel + q&a. Rehearsal window Wed 1:45-2:10pm PT. Can everyone make that?

aya: Wed works for me. Suggest we include a 1-line customer quote in the registration blurb to boost signups.

kendra: I'll own inbound lead routing. Proposed tags: trial-ready, dev-interest, enterprise. Can map triggers after we agree the reg form fields.

maria: routing triggers idea: job_title contains "Engineer" + company_size>50 -> dev-interest; watched demo + registered -> trial-ready; corporate domain match -> enterprise. Kendra, can you draft rules and a test plan?

kendra: Yep — will post rules in #marketing-ops and set up a dry-run. Also will add a webhook test to ensure SalesOps receives trial-ready leads.

maria: @devon for the benchmark abstract, please include quick bullets: p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and an example throughput scenario. Keep it 2 lines for registration.

devon: Will do. Tentative snippet I'll include:
```
Model | p95 | cost/1k
open-13b-q | 180ms | $0.12
rdw-7b-quant | 95ms | $0.08
```

sam: Draft demo abstract: "Live walk-through: integrate Redwood API + prefix cache to cut inference spend ~40% while keeping p95 <120ms." Thoughts?

maria: Nice. Add one sentence about production-grade fallbacks (canary routing + variant fallback) so enterprise folks see reliability.

eric: For rehearsal we should simulate a model failure and show automated reroute. Need eng-oncall to flip routing during the test.

ops-bot: Rehearsal maintenance window reserved: Wed 1:50pm-1:58pm PT. Ticket #2345.

eng-oncall: We can do 1:50-1:58 but need the exact steps. Eric, can you post the one-liner to flip routing?

eric: One-liner (staging): `curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/route/switch -d '{"route":"backup"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'` — that triggers the fallback path. I'll draft a 3-step runbook.

aya: Abstract length note: keep registration blurb to 2 sentences + up to 3 outcome bullets. Long paragraphs don't convert.

maria: Owners recap:
- Benchmarks: devon
- Demo: sam + eric
- Customer quote & panel coordination: aya
- Lead routing + tests: kendra

maria: Deadline for draft abstracts: Tue EOD. I'll consolidate and send to design Wed AM for landing page + social copy.

kendra: I'll run a routing dry-run after drafts land and share results. Will create a checklist for SalesOps handoff.

maria: Also need to confirm moderator and panel invites. Aya, can you reach out to the customer speaker and a partner panelist?

aya: On it. Will ping them today and aim to secure confirmations by Tue.

sam: Quick Q: do we have an honorarium guideline for external speakers?

maria: Yes — external speakers get standard honorarium; reach out to people-ops for specifics. Internal presenters follow internal policy.

devon: I'll upload the raw benchmark CSV to this thread when ready.

maria: Thanks. Final logistics: rehearsal is Wed 1:45-2:10pm PT (we'll practice the failover at 1:50). If anything blocks, flag here ASAP.

eric: small conflict: I have a call at 2:00-2:20. Can we keep the rehearsal to end by 2:05?

eng-oncall: 1:45-2:05 is fine for us.

devon: I have a 2:15 conflict too, but 1:45-2:05 works.

maria: OK — final rehearsal slot 1:45-2:05pm PT. I'll update calendar invites and post runbook. Thanks everyone.
